profile.headline: Developer, designer, and problem-solver at the intersection of tech and creativity.
profile.summary:
I graduated from California State University Chico in December 2012 with a B.S. in Applied Computer Graphics. At Chico State I took many project based classes that fostered both my creative skills and my technical knowledge. I know what it takes to produce a finished piece of work and I have the experience to do so on time. I also have plenty of experience working in groups to complete projects so I know how to work well with others. I am an experienced Web designer/programmer who is always looking for new projects to test my skills.

Specialties: Web design and programing (XHTML, HTML, CSS), Experience using and implementing various CMS platforms (Wordpress, Joomla), Experience using Elementor Pro to build websites and creating my own custom Elementor widgets, Photo development/Photo-manipulation (Adobe Photoshop), Video Creation (Adobe Premier Pro, Adobe After Effects), Digital Painting (Adobe Photoshop), 3D Modeling/Texturing (Autodesk Maya)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained custom websites using Elementor, Divi, and Shopify, including theme customization and original widget creation
Designed and implemented ActiveCampaign email campaigns, automations, and managed segmented mailing lists
Led accessibility initiatives, creating and updating websites to meet WCAG compliance standards
Built custom accessible navigation and accordion components
Created custom tools using the Google Maps API, including a custom location finder
Trained clients in updating and managing their websites independently through personalized in-person sessions, video conferencing, and custom tutorial creation
positions.insights: Skills: Shopify theme development · Accessible web development · Elementor Pro

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
Built and maintained eCommerce and content sites using Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, and WordPress
Developed interactive elements and contributed to internal tools like Better Together Inventory
Utilized Angular and MVC architecture to build dynamic, scalable frontend features
Integrated various JS libraries

positions.title: Information Technology Supervisor
positions.description:
Managed and maintained the organization’s website, ensuring it was current and functional
Oversaw the school’s IT infrastructure, including setting up computers, printers, and managing the network
Set up and maintained iPad and MacBook carts, preparing them for classroom use
Provided technical support to staff and trained teachers on educational software and digital tools
Designed the church’s logo, which is still in active use today

positions.title: Concept Artist
positions.description: Producing high quality concept art for assets and locations to be included in a mobile game titled "Galactic Enforcer".

positions.title: Environmental Artist
positions.description: Modeled and textured various low polly assets to be used in a couple different mobile games.

positions.title: 3D Environment Modeler
positions.description: Modeled and textured 3D game assets for a full scale PC game titled "Communist vs Zombies" using Autodesk Maya and Adobe Photoshop. I gained valuable experience working in a production pipeline and creating low polly game models.

positions.title: Asset Modeler/Texture Intern
positions.description: Model and texture various items to be used in a children's animated tv show.

positions.title: Asset Modeler/Texture Intern
positions.description: I Modeled and Textured a bunch of different assets to be used in the Crab Cove animated series.

positions.title: Student Coordinator
positions.description: Lead the rest of the Student Leaders in organizing and planning various events, fundraising and making sure things are getting done. I also am in charge of updating the website.

positions.title: Student Leader
positions.description: I assisted in planning and carrying out various events for the Catholic college students at Chico State (including designing advertisements for my events) as well as lock and unlock the building and holding 2 office hours each week.

company.name: St. Thomas Aquinas Newman Catholic Center

positions.title: Remodel Team Member
positions.description: Worked 25 hrs/week. Worked with a team to take down and set up card holding displays as well as restocking cards, inventorying cards and helping customers find cards. This gave me valuable experience in working with others to complete a project and having a deadline to meet.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: I was in charge of Scanning documents, data entry, preparing mailings, answering the phone, cleaning and locking up at this Financial Consultant's Office

projects.title: The Catholic Telegraph
projects.description: I built this web based magazine site using Wordpress and Elementor. I had to use complex custom queries to pull in different types of news feeds as needed.

projects.title: Website | Process of Evangelization and Discipleship
projects.description: I developed a site to walk people through the journey of evangelization including a diagram that animates as the user scrolls down the page. I developed this page using the Elementor page builder overlayed with lots of custom HTML, Javascript and CSS.
